basic_profile.headline: Founding Engineer | Backend + Infra | Built fintech payments at ₹90Cr/mo & EKS at 2M req/day | Node.js · TypeScript · Python · AWS · Kubernetes · NACH · NBFC
basic_profile.name: Shreyans Sonthalia
basic_profile.summary: I'm a backend + platform engineer with 5+ years of building and operating production fintech systems end-to-end — from MySQL schema to the Kubernetes Job that runs in production at 2 a.m. At Propelld (NBFC lending), I've shipped both sides of the stack: Backend / product (what I built) • JIT NACH presentation system processing 2L+ presentations worth ₹90Cr+/month across multiple lenders, with idempotency and double-debit prevention. • Automated lender-reallocation engine that recovers 13% of rejections — ~₹6.52Cr/month — with zero manual review. • Edgro NBFC onboarding backend: credit consent, PAN encryption-at-rest, co-applicant risk, audit-traceable consent revocation. • Cut daily support tickets from 20–25 to 2–3 by fixing root causes in 6 months. Platform / infra (what I operate) • Migrated 100+ microservices from VMs to EKS with zero downtime; scaled to 3× traffic. • Cut AWS spend 25–30% ($30K+/yr) via RI planning, ECR lifecycle, self-hosted Prometheus/Grafana replacing CloudWatch. • Project Milkyway: zero-downtime RDS Blue/Green migration io1 → gp3, 88% cost cut, sub-1-min switchover. • Mitigated a live DDoS using Athena + Glue + WAF rules written under pressure. • Owned VAPT audits, BCP/DR strategy, and led a 4-person platform team. Stack: Node.js, TypeScript, Python, AWS (EKS, RDS, WAF, Athena, Glue, Lambda), Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, Jenkins, Prometheus, Grafana, MySQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Redis. Domain depth: NACH / NACH JIT, NBFC lending, disbursals, collections, KYC (HyperVerge, Digio), Account Aggregator.

current.company_description: Propelld is a series-B funded fintech company that enables flexible financing solutions through fully digital journeys for learners pursuing education programs at vetted partner institutions.Having vertical expertise in the education segment, Propelld provides tailored financing solutions for various educational programs and goes beyond traditional credit parameters to focus on students' learning capabilities and employment potential to assess their eligibility for a loan, all backed by an agile tech infrastructure.From our origin in 2017, we have been driven by the mission of truly democratizing access to education by revolutionizing the face of financing for the entire educational ecosystem. On this journey, we've added more than 2000+ institute partners, with which we're leading in the Ed-tech, Skill-Up, and Job-focused education segment and now expanding in other education segments.We're growing, and our strength, backing us, is our team, which encompasses the potential to create an empire from scratch, performs best on role autonomy, and is data-driven.
current.description:
• Designed & shipped an automated lender-reallocation engine that re-routes rejected applications to eligible lenders — recovers 13% of rejections (~₹6.52Cr/month, ~652 apps) with zero manual review.

• Built JIT NACH presentation as a Kubernetes Job across multiple lenders (incl. ABFL): 2L+ presentations worth ₹90Cr+/month, with idempotency, double-debit prevention, and failure recovery.

• Led Edgro NBFC infra from greenfield to production — VPC, EKS, MongoDB (managed + self-hosted), CI/CD, observability. Serves 2M+ requests/day with zero-downtime cutover.

• Project Milkyway: zero-downtime RDS Blue/Green migration (io1 1TB → gp3 200GB), <1 min switchover, 88% cost cut ($633 → $76/month, ~$6,683/yr saved), IOPS held at 3000.

• Cut total AWS spend 25–30% via RI planning, ECR lifecycle policies, and replacing CloudWatch with self-managed Prometheus + Grafana.

• Owned the Communications Platform end-to-end — RabbitMQ priority queues for WhatsApp/Email/SMS, EMI reminder scheduling, Digio webhook handling.

• Built Edgro onboarding backend: credit consent flow, PAN blacklist API, PAN encryption-at-rest, co-applicant risk, audit-traceable consent revocation.

• Mitigated a live DDoS using AWS Athena + Glue for log analysis and writing WAF rules in real time.

• Led VAPT security audits — cut audit cycle time 50% YoY; integrated ClamAV scanning, executed secrets cleanup, enforced WAF IP whitelisting.

• Wrote Jenkins Shared Libraries standardising CI/CD across 100+ services; rebuilt Docker pipeline with multi-stage builds (60–70% smaller images).

• Support-ticket reduction: daily volume from 20–25 → 2–3. Designed BCP/DR for all of Propelld infra. Led & mentored a 4-person platform team.

Stack: Node.js, TypeScript, AWS (EKS, RDS, WAF, Athena, Glue), Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, Jenkins, Prometheus, Grafana, MySQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ.

past.description:
• Architected and executed migration of 100+ microservices from bare VMs to EKS across dev, staging, and production — scaled to handle 3× traffic growth with zero downtime.

• Built the company's Jenkins CI/CD pipeline from scratch, cutting manual deployment effort 70%+ and enabling rapid automated releases across the engineering team.

• Set up Prometheus + Grafana monitoring from scratch for services, infra, and application-level metrics.

• Implemented AWS WAF rate limiting and IP whitelisting, hardening edge security for all public-facing services.

• Integrated HyperVerge into the InstaKYC flow, lifting identity-verification accuracy from 6% to 17%.

• Developed a shared MySQL utility library using connection-pool promises — reduced total DB connection count and improved query throughput under concurrent load.

• Built a loan-journey event tracking system giving product and ops visibility into TAT and application blockers at each stage of the loan funnel.

past.company_description: Practo is dedicated to improving health outcomes by enabling patients and healthcare providers to make informed decisions. The platform leverages computer science and data science to ensure that every interaction contributes to better health outcomes.Founded 17 years ago, Practo is a homegrown healthcare technology company that has continuously evolved, setting benchmarks in the industry. From building practice management software and helping doctors go digital to pioneering telemedicine before the pandemic, launching Clinic Excellence Scores for greater transparency, and now rolling out AI-powered tools to support clinical decision-making, Practo has stayed at the forefront of innovation. As technology becomes integral to healthcare, Practo plays a crucial role in helping doctors manage and securely store health data. Practo encrypts all data with 256-bit encryption, uses HIPAA-compliant data centres, and is ISO 27001 certified, making it one of the few healthcare companies to achieve this level of security. Demonstrating its commitment to the highest standards of medical quality and patient care, Practo became the first digital healthcare company to receive QAI accreditation for its medical quality. This prestigious accreditation underscores Practo's dedication to excellence in healthcare.Now operating in 22+ countries, Practo recently expanded its consumer platform to the UAE, building on its existing presence on the provider side. The platform has, to date, connected over 50 crore patients and now brings together more than 5 lakh doctors and healthcare providers across 900 cities. In the UAE alone, Practo now has over 50,000 monthly active users, with 3,000 healthcare facilities and 31,000+ doctors already live. This expansive reach and robust infrastructure generate a staggering ₹3,500 crore+ of value every year, underscoring Practo’s growing impact not just in India but across the global healthcare landscape.
